scope:
Assisted native pilot of the two real northern Marseille terrain windows.

Production HTML and HTTP, installed source files, actual terrain reads and
rendered triangles are used. Diagnostic sector selection, render/simulation
freeze and measured collision-free camera placement are declared assistance.
No HTML, responses, terrain, actors or storage are injected or substituted.

checks.name: Frozen installed source index is exact
Both real northern grids belong to the receipt-pinned regional bundle
Actual inline dependency is pinned: src/v050/04_source_geometry.js
Actual inline dependency is pinned: src/v050/04a_city_sources.js
Actual inline dependency is pinned: src/v050/14_precise_terrain.js

assistance: Render and simulation frozen for repeatable terrain observations.
Camera placed only after finite measured source and actual body-collision checks.
limitations: Two bounded northern Marseille rectangles; not whole Marseille or reconstructed station/port architecture.
WGS84 nearest-resampled nodes, requested spacing 1 m, not the original native half-metre lattice.
Rendered triangle samples and screenshots are assisted observations, not a human walk through every place.
